title: Brand kit

charter.clearSpaceBody: Keep a free space around the logo at least equal to half the height of the symbol. No text or image may enter it.
charter.minSizeBody: Full version: at least 30 mm (120 px) wide. Below that, use the icon only (16 px minimum).

social.title: Social media kit
social.body: Profile pictures and banners sized for each network, with the logo inside the area visible on both mobile and desktop. Included in the ZIP archive.
social.free: Preview of your social media visuals. Downloads are included in paid plans.
